name: se7enxweb/sevenx_paypal
description: PayPal Checkout for Exponential: PayPal's current REST APIs (Orders v2, Payments v2, Webhooks v1) with the PayPal JS SDK buttons (PayPal, Pay Later and cards where PayPal offers them). A shop payment gateway, buttons for any page, authorize-then-capture, refunds, verified and idempotent webhooks, and a status page in the administration. Credentials live in the kernel's secret store, never in INI files. Not the classic ezpaypal, IPN or NVP integration.
